description: Models with the lowest listed price on Ezkielyna for a task: chat, coding (models that also work with Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode style agents), image (price per image) or tts (price per 1M characters). Shows uptime next to each price and by default leaves out models whose 7-day uptime is below 90%. Only covers this one gateway, not a market-wide price comparison. Free, no API key.

min_uptime_7d.description: Leave out models whose known 7-day uptime is below this. Models without status data are kept and marked.
